text:
maya: Heads-up: new A.I. partner sent a model license that forbids any distribution outside 'research non-commercial' and requires express written permission for marketplace listing. This blocks our planned cloud marketplace hosted SKU and the SI edge kit preinstall. Thoughts?

ren: Big problem for marketplace visibility. We can present it as a hosted-only integration (no redistributed weights) but need explicit language allowing 'listing as a hosted offering' + marketing cooperation.

tess: From product: customers expect 'supported on Redwood' in marketplace tiles. That's OK without weights, but hardware partners expect preloaded images. If we can't redistribute, timeline slips. Also need to check revenue-share assumptions if we move to a managed-download model.

owen: Eng: feasible workaround — implement a secure, signed-first-boot pull that downloads weights from supplier-hosted storage or our proxy. Key pieces: signed manifest, checksum, per-device auth, and an offline verification fallback. That avoids embedding weights in the image.

maya: Legal: can we request a small carve-out to allow (1) hosting as a service, (2) marketplace listing as a hosted offering, and (3) controlled device retrieval for approved SI partners?

ren: Suggested clause to propose: ```
Permitted Conduct: Supplier grants Redwood the non-exclusive right to (a) operate the Model as a hosted service and list such offering on cloud marketplaces; (b) coordinate marketing and co-branding for such hosted listings; and (c) enable distribution of the Model to specified SI partners via secure, authenticated retrieval mechanisms strictly for installation into finished device SKUs identified in a schedule. Any transfer of raw model weight files to third parties or inclusion in redistributable images requires a separate Redistribution Addendum.
```

tess: That looks good. Also add export-control and territory restrictions (sales to embargoed regions prohibited) — we'll loop in compliance.

owen: Tech note: if supplier insists weights never leave their control, we can proxy the download but need SLA on bandwidth and signed URLs. We'll prototype a signed-manifest flow and a device-side verifier. ETA 3 days for a minimal prototype.

maya: Marketing asks: can we still plan a joint announcement for marketplace availability if redistribution is limited? Supplier wants a PR. We can do one for the hosted listing, but any 'supported on device' messaging must be conditional on the redistribution addendum for preloads. Need 72hr embargo and supplier-approved quotes.

marketplace-bot: listing-draft: ml-draft-1457 created in staging  status: pending-legal

ren: Action plan: 1) I'll send the proposed carve-out to supplier legal today. 2) @owen start POC for signed manifest. 3) @tess prepare comms drafts for hosted-only announcement and a conditional HW messaging variant. 4) @maya coordinate SI expectations and ask for Schedule A (SKU list).

maya: I'll also ask supplier to confirm whether they allow checksum + signed manifest downloads; if they refuse we escalate to commercial for redistribution addendum request.

owen: POC repo link will go to #eng-runtime; will ping this thread when ready.

tess: I'll draft two PR blurbs (hosted listing + conditional device availability) and add an embargo placeholder.

maya: Thanks — keeping decisions here. We'll reconvene after supplier reply and POC.
